style: Playful, cute 2D cartoon; moderate detail and a shared head/neck/bust reference

reference.prompt: Create ONE funny, lovable CARTOON MASCOT portrait for a Saudi friends-and-food app. This must be unmistakably a playful illustrated character, NOT a portrait of a human, NOT realistic, NOT a detailed 3D human model. STYLE: cozy hand-drawn 2D mobile-game sticker art with rounded chunky shapes, a soft warm brown outline, very simple two-tone shading, muted sage/cream/terracotta palette. Think charming storybook comedy character. FACE: plump rounded cheeks, little bean-shaped black eyes with tiny white glints, thick short expressive curved eyebrows, small squishy button nose, a cheeky asymmetric closed-mouth smile lifting one cheek, subtle peach blush. Slightly raised eyebrow gives gentle Saudi-friend 'I already ordered dessert' energy. NO teeth or huge grin, NO skin texture, NO individual hairs, NO realistic eyelashes, NO photographic face. Hair is 3-4 big soft dark-brown swoops. Ears small. Head is softly round and a little oversized, connected naturally to a SHORT STURDY NECK and rounded shoulders; no floating head and no narrow long stalk. Wears a relaxed sage-green crew-neck TOP BUST with simple seams and a tiny embroidered palm doodle. Clothing must fit the body naturally and meet neck exactly. Head-and-upper-chest only, straight front view and symmetric shoulders, completely visible in a square canvas except chest cropped at bottom. Center face x=.5, crown at y=.12, chin y=.64, collar y=.70, shoulders x=.12..88 y=.74, chest to bottom. Plain warm ivory background. No words, no border, no objects, no hands. The result must feel silly and cute and warm, but still a distinct illustrated character rather than a yellow emoji. Keep visual detail deliberately low-to-medium and focus on strong appealing silhouette and gentle humor.
